name: Uplay R1 (Ubisoft Connect / upc_r1 loader)
notes: Auto-selected when any file named in detect.loader_dll_names is found anywhere in the game folder (search excludes the script's own core/adapters folders). assets_folder_glob points at the 'UplayR1-*' folder that must be placed inside this adapter folder (adapters/uplay_r1/), containing upc_r1.ini/uplay_r1.ini + loader DLL templates. write_config.ps1 fails with a clear error (asking the user to redownload the latest Uplay R1 emulator files) if that folder is missing or incomplete.
